title: Against 1...e6, 1...c6 and 1...d5
intro: Meet 1...e6 and 1...c6 with Nf3, g3 and Bg2. Against 1...d5, trade on d5 and gain time against Black's queen.
variation: c2c4 e7e6, c2c4 c7c6, c2c4 d7d5

lessons.title: Meeting 1...e6
lessons.summary: Use Nf3, g3 and Bg2 to reach a strong Catalan set-up.

steps.text: Against 1...e6, White starts 2.Nf3 to prepare g3 and Bg2 without committing d4 right away.

steps.hint: Push c4, then develop the king's knight.

steps.text: Black takes space in the centre with 2...d5.

steps.ifRight: Notice that c4 is safe: if ...dxc4, White wins it back easily with Qa4+.

steps.text: Put your bishop on the long diagonal.
steps.ifRight: Next White castles and plays d4 to reach a strong Catalan.

steps.hint: Push the d-pawn two squares to pressure Black's queenside.
steps.ifWrong: Play 6.d4 to enter a pleasant Catalan position.
steps.ifRight: Your g2 bishop rakes the long diagonal.

lessons.title: Meeting 1...c6
lessons.summary: Fianchetto and punish an early ...Bf5 with cxd5 and Qb3.

steps.text: Against 1...c6, White uses the same Nf3, g3 and Bg2 set-up. Here Black often brings the bishop out with 4...Bf5.
Open the c-file before Black gets comfortable.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.cxd5 to expose Black's b7 pawn.
steps.ifRight: Once Black takes back, your queen can target b7.

steps.text: Attack both b7 and d5 with your queen.
steps.ifWrong: Play 6.Qb3 to put immediate pressure on b7 and d5.
steps.ifRight: Black must spend time defending b7.

steps.text: What if Black grabs the pawn with 4...dxc4?
steps.hint: Castle first, or prepare to win c4 back with Na3 or Qc2.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.O-O (or 5.Na3): the c4 pawn cannot be held for long.
steps.ifRight: White wins the pawn back with Qc2 or Na3 and keeps a lead in development.

steps.text: If Black plays solidly with 4...e6, keep developing.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.O-O, then continue with b3 and Bb2 or d4.
steps.ifRight: Calm and solid, with clear plans.

lessons.title: Meeting 1...d5
lessons.summary: Trade on d5 and chase Black's queen with Nc3.

steps.text: Sometimes Black plays 1...d5 right away, hoping for a reversed Scandinavian.

steps.ifWrong: Play 2.cxd5 so Black must bring the queen out or spend time with ...Nf6.
steps.ifRight: You gain time if Black takes with the queen.

steps.text: Develop a knight and chase Black's queen.
steps.hint: Attack the queen with your queen's knight.
steps.ifWrong: Play 3.Nc3 to gain a free tempo against the queen.
steps.ifRight: After 3...Qa5, White continues with Nf3, g3 and Bg2.
